title: Reproducing Deal, Sklar, Grove and Snow 1967: fixed charge and the last hot step

specimen.paper: “single crystal Czochralski type … circular slices approximately 2 cm in diameter”, lapped to 250 µm; (111), (110) and (100)
specimen.note: We hold no (110) rows from this paper.

specimen.paper: “Both p- and n-type dopants (boron and phosphorus) … ~10^16 cm-3”; Table I: p-type, boron, 1.4 × 10^16 cm-3
specimen.ours: DOPING: p_type_boron_1p4e16 (recorded; no program reads it)
specimen.note: Tables II and III do not say which conductivity type each value is from.

specimen.paper: Chemically polished in 4HF:10HNO3, about 50 µm removed per side
0.20 µm for Table I and for every point of Figure 3
specimen.ours: not a specimen property in ours: the oxide is grown by the history
specimen.note: Below 920 °C the paper's oxides were grown at 1200 °C and then held at the lower temperature, so the thickness was not grown at the temperature the charge is quoted for.

specimen.paper: Aluminium field plates 375 µm in diameter, or a gold pressure probe on bare oxide

history.paper: “cleaned in both organic and inorganic solvents using ultrasonic agitation … chemically polished in a 4HF:10HNO3 solution … Approximately 50µ per side were removed”
history.note: The vocabulary's list of cleans has no entry for an HF-nitric chemical polish.

history.item: Slices flat on a quartz boat, into the tube
history.paper: “placed flat on a thin quartz boat and inserted in a tube furnace with separate systems being used for n- and p-type samples”
“(Samples were oxidized at 1200°C for 60 min. xo = 0.2µ.” (Table I caption)
history.ours: RUN Oxidation DURATION 3600 TEMP 1200->1200 AMBIENT dry_O2
history.note: The datasets' recipe for this row has no oxidation: the charge program starts from its steady state in oxygen at this temperature.

history.paper: “the standard one being very rapid (less than 3 sec through the 50 cm from the center of the furnace to the end of the tube)”
history.ours: RUN Pull DURATION 3 TEMP 1200->400 AMBIENT dry_O2
history.note: The paper gives the time to travel the tube, not the wafer's temperature against time. A straight fall to 400 °C is ours; 400 °C was chosen because it fits Table I best among 300 to 800 °C.

history.item: 50–100 Å of oxide removed in dilute HF, back oxide removed
history.paper: “metallized with aluminum on the top surface after first removing 50-100Å of oxide in a 10:1 H2O:HF solution”
history.note: The 0.2 µm oxide is thinned by 2.5 to 5%; no program reads it.

history.paper: “metallized with aluminum on the top surface”; selected samples instead measured bare with a gold probe
history.note: Which tabulated samples took which route is not identified. The deposition method is not given.

history.item: Heat treatment after metal, 550 °C in nitrogen
history.paper: “Finally, the slices were heat treated at 550°C for 2-5 min in dry nitrogen.”
history.ours: RUN MetalAnneal DURATION 210 TEMP 550->550 AMBIENT inert_N2
history.note: Not in the datasets' recipe. Written here as 3.5 min, the middle of the stated range; it applies to the metallized samples only.

history.paper: “Capacitance measurement frequency was about 100 kc and measurements were at 25°C.” Reproducibility “always better than 5 × 10^10 cm-2”

steps.name: Polish
steps.label: Solvent clean and chemical polish
steps.paper: “cleaned in both organic and inorganic solvents using ultrasonic agitation … chemically polished in a 4HF:10HNO3 solution … Approximately 50µ per side were removed”

steps.name: Load
steps.label: Slices flat on a quartz boat, into the tube
steps.paper: “placed flat on a thin quartz boat and inserted in a tube furnace with separate systems being used for n- and p-type samples”
steps.timing: Push rate and push gas not given

steps.name: Oxidation
steps.label: Dry oxidation at 1200 °C
steps.isl: RUN Oxidation DURATION 3600 TEMP 1200->1200 AMBIENT dry_O2
steps.paper: “(Samples were oxidized at 1200°C for 60 min. xo = 0.2µ.” (Table I caption)
steps.timing: 60 min, from the Table I caption; Tables II and III give no time

steps.name: Pull
steps.label: Pull from the furnace, 3 s
steps.isl: RUN Pull DURATION 3 TEMP 1200->400 AMBIENT dry_O2
steps.paper: “the standard one being very rapid (less than 3 sec through the 50 cm from the center of the furnace to the end of the tube)”
steps.timing: “less than 3 sec” is a bound; 3 s used; the end temperature is not given and is searched from 25 to 700 °C

steps.name: Strip
steps.label: 50–100 Å of oxide removed in dilute HF, back oxide removed
steps.paper: “metallized with aluminum on the top surface after first removing 50-100Å of oxide in a 10:1 H2O:HF solution”

steps.name: Metal
steps.label: Aluminium field plates, 375 µm
steps.paper: “metallized with aluminum on the top surface”; selected samples instead measured bare with a gold probe

steps.name: MetalAnneal
steps.label: Heat treatment after metal, 550 °C in nitrogen
steps.isl: RUN MetalAnneal DURATION 210 TEMP 550->550 AMBIENT inert_N2
steps.paper: “Finally, the slices were heat treated at 550°C for 2-5 min in dry nitrogen.”
steps.timing: “2-5 min”; 3.5 min used, searched from 2 to 5 min

steps.timing: “2-5 min”; 3.5 min used, searched from 2 to 5 min

steps.name: CV
steps.label: C-V at about 100 kc, 25 °C
steps.paper: “Capacitance measurement frequency was about 100 kc and measurements were at 25°C.” Reproducibility “always better than 5 × 10^10 cm-2”

steps.name: Polish
steps.label: Solvent clean and chemical polish
steps.paper: “cleaned in both organic and inorganic solvents using ultrasonic agitation … chemically polished in a 4HF:10HNO3 solution … Approximately 50µ per side were removed”

steps.name: Load
steps.label: Slices flat on a quartz boat, into the tube
steps.paper: “placed flat on a thin quartz boat and inserted in a tube furnace with separate systems being used for n- and p-type samples”
steps.timing: Push rate and push gas not given

steps.name: Oxidation
steps.label: Dry oxidation at 1200 °C
steps.isl: RUN Oxidation DURATION 3600 TEMP 1200->1200 AMBIENT dry_O2
steps.paper: “(Samples were oxidized at 1200°C for 60 min. xo = 0.2µ.” (Table I caption)
steps.timing: 60 min, from the Table I caption; Tables II and III give no time

steps.name: OxygenHold
steps.label: Held in dry oxygen at 550 °C, 90 min
steps.isl: RUN OxygenHold DURATION 5400 TEMP 550->550 AMBIENT dry_O2
steps.paper: Table III A: “O2 at 550°C for 90 min”; text says “nearly 1 hr at 550°C”
steps.timing: 90 min in Table III; “nearly 1 hr” in the text

steps.name: Pull
steps.label: Pull from the furnace, 3 s
steps.isl: RUN Pull DURATION 3 TEMP 550->400 AMBIENT dry_O2
steps.paper: “the standard one being very rapid (less than 3 sec through the 50 cm from the center of the furnace to the end of the tube)”
steps.timing: “less than 3 sec” is a bound; 3 s used; the end temperature is not given and is searched from 25 to 700 °C

steps.name: Strip
steps.label: 50–100 Å of oxide removed in dilute HF, back oxide removed
steps.paper: “metallized with aluminum on the top surface after first removing 50-100Å of oxide in a 10:1 H2O:HF solution”

steps.name: Metal
steps.label: Aluminium field plates, 375 µm
steps.paper: “metallized with aluminum on the top surface”; selected samples instead measured bare with a gold probe
